GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 3 Wide last 10 Lengths 800m 3 Wide 10th 8 Lengths home turn Under Pressure last 12 Lengths broke down 300m Stewards: Post race Vet officer found to have catastrophic injury and was euthanised # horse euthanised

Jumped Well . Settled Down Inside 11th 7 Lengths @ 1200m. off fence Straightening Up . tried to weave a path in Straight , Kept Finding line not much room in straight at times . winner led # worked home well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after the start, was bumped. Was held up for clear running from near the 250m until after passing the 200m. Passing the 100m, was again held up for a short distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 6th 6 Lengths 800m 6th 5 Lengths home turn 7th Hooked Out Middle Of Track ran on well final 200m # ran on well late

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (7L from lead). Back 1 length midrace until improving on inside from 600m & held up Two Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Held up until pushed out Four Wide @ 250m & pressured @ 200m. Ran on OK in last 150m. # Margin unfair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was slightly inconvenienced by the weakening of another runner and had to be directed out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 7 lengths. well back turn. battled away # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward if circumstances permit; settled off-midfield. Passing the 800m got its head up and commenced to overrace for some distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Settled Down 4th Outside 3l same all way to Straightening Up couldn't quicken battled on one pace to the line , well beaten by third # end of prep run ?

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vet exam prior to race and was passed fit to start.
